english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a contradiction, especially a logical inconsistency or conflict.
Use this as the everyday all-purpose choice when the paradox involves an apparent contradiction or conflicting outcome.

examples.english: Saying we want to save money but ending up spending more is a real paradox.
